note: Per-film readings. Predicaments are free text on purpose — the vocabulary is mined from them afterwards, not imposed before. `relatives` is NOT an edge list: see the header of readings.js.

films.title: Rashomon
films.engine: A samurai is dead in a grove, and every person who was there tells the court a version in which they are the one who acted with some kind of honour — the bandit, the wife, the dead man through a medium, and finally the woodcutter who claims to have watched it all. The film is about what happens to the men listening: two of them cannot get the accounts to line up, and the one insisting hardest on the truth turns out to have been hiding a theft of his own.

predicaments.situation: several people give incompatible accounts of one event, each account arranged so its teller is not the shameful one
predicaments.basis: Tajōmaru, the wife, the dead samurai and the woodcutter each narrate the killing differently, and each version assigns its narrator the least degrading role.

roles.telling: Tajōmaru, the wife, the samurai (via medium), the woodcutter

predicaments.situation: a witness suppresses what he saw because telling it would expose a small crime of his own
predicaments.basis: The woodcutter claims he only found the body, then admits he watched the killing, and is finally accused of having lied to hide that he stole the wife's dagger.

predicaments.situation: a person is violated and then treated by their own people as the one who has been spoiled
predicaments.basis: After the rape the wife is met with her husband's contempt and loathing, and in the woodcutter's account he refuses to fight for a woman he now considers ruined.

predicaments.situation: two men are pushed into a fight neither wants by a third party who insists they settle her worth
predicaments.basis: In the woodcutter's telling the wife taunts both men until they duel clumsily and unwillingly, ending in the samurai begging for his life.

predicaments.situation: someone loses their belief in other people and has it returned by one unremarkable act
predicaments.basis: The monk, sickened by the trial and by the commoner stripping the abandoned baby, recoils from the woodcutter until he learns the man means to raise the child.

relatives.title: The Last Duel
relatives.shares: one assault narrated three times, each version shaped by what its teller needs to have been true

relatives.title: Anatomy of a Fall
relatives.shares: a death that no surviving account can settle, leaving listeners to choose which version to live with

relatives.title: A Separation
relatives.shares: ordinary people lying in small self-protective ways until the truth of an event becomes unrecoverable

relatives.title: The Thin Blue Line
relatives.shares: incompatible eyewitness testimony about a killing, with each witness's stake in their own version visible

relatives.title: Hero
relatives.shares: competing reconstructions of the same encounter, each told to persuade a listener rather than to report

films.title: Seven Samurai
films.engine: A village that expects to be robbed after harvest hires masterless warriors who will work for food, and the arrangement forces each side to face what it has done to the other — farmers who murdered wounded samurai for their armour, samurai whose wars made the farmers into scavengers. The defence works, at a cost that falls mostly on the hired men, and when it is over the people who were saved go back to planting while the survivors stand at the graves with no share in the life they preserved.

predicaments.situation: a community with nothing to pay with hires protectors it also fears and has previously wronged
predicaments.basis: The farmers offer only rice, greet the samurai coldly, and are exposed when Kikuchiyo produces armour looted from dying samurai.

predicaments.situation: a man who belongs fully to neither of two groups appoints himself the translator between them and is destroyed in the gap
predicaments.basis: Kikuchiyo, a farmer's son passing as a samurai, shames the samurai on the farmers' behalf and then abandons his post for glory before dying to kill the bandit chief.

predicaments.situation: two people cross a line their society draws and the crossing cannot survive the end of the emergency
predicaments.basis: Katsushirō and Shino know their classes forbid them; her father beats her when he finds out, and after the battle she walks past him to rejoin the planting.

predicaments.situation: someone taken by force is found again by the person who lost them and refuses to be reclaimed
predicaments.basis: Rikichi sees his wife in the burning bandit camp and she runs back into the fire rather than return to him.

predicaments.situation: individuals are told to abandon their own homes for the sake of the whole and one will not
predicaments.basis: Kambei orders the outlying houses evacuated over the owners' objections, and Gisaku refuses to leave his mill, killing his family with him.

predicaments.situation: the people who won a fight get nothing from the victory they secured for someone else
predicaments.basis: Kambei stands before four burial mounds and tells Shichirōji the farmers are the real victors.

relatives.title: Shane
relatives.shares: a fighting man defends settled people and cannot remain among them once the fighting is done

relatives.title: High Noon
relatives.shares: the question of whether a community will stand and fight for itself or hire the danger away

relatives.title: The Wild Bunch
relatives.shares: men whose trade is violence discovering the world they fight in has no further use for them

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: the protector left outside the door of the household his violence made safe

relatives.title: Assault on Precinct 13
relatives.shares: a mismatched, mutually distrustful set of defenders holding a fixed position against repeated assaults

films.title: Once Upon a Time in the West
films.engine: A family is slaughtered on a patch of desert because it has the only water on the route of a coming railroad, and the widow who arrives a day too late inherits both the land and everyone who wants it. Circling this is a man who will not give his name, keeping the killer alive against other killers so that he can be the one to do it, and so that the killer can be told, at the last possible moment, what he is dying for.

predicaments.situation: a person organises their whole life around making one specific man understand, at the point of death, why he is being killed
predicaments.basis: Harmonica shadows Frank, saves him from Morton's bribed men because of unfinished business, and pushes the harmonica into his mouth as he dies so the reason lands.

predicaments.situation: a child is made the physical instrument of a family member's execution
predicaments.basis: The flashback shows Frank standing the boy under his hanging brother, harmonica in his mouth, until the boy's legs give out.

predicaments.situation: an outsider marries into a household and inherits it through the murder of the family she has just joined
predicaments.basis: Jill arrives at Sweetwater from New Orleans a month after the wedding to find McBain and his children dead, and becomes the owner of the land they were killed for.

predicaments.situation: a hired enforcer exceeds his instructions and turns on the man who bought him
predicaments.basis: Morton hired Frank only to frighten McBain off; Frank murders the family and moves to take the land himself, and the two try to have each other killed.

predicaments.situation: a man is framed for a crime by someone who needs the blame to land elsewhere
predicaments.basis: Frank plants evidence at Sweetwater implicating Cheyenne, who spends the film a hunted fugitive denying acts that were not his.

predicaments.situation: the men who cleared the ground for someone's future have no place in it
predicaments.basis: With Frank dead, Harmonica rides away carrying Cheyenne's body while Jill carries water to the railroad crew.

relatives.title: Oldboy
relatives.shares: a revenge whose entire point is that the target must be made to understand the reason before he is finished

relatives.title: Lady Snowblood
relatives.shares: a life shaped from childhood into a single instrument aimed at named men

relatives.title: There Will Be Blood
relatives.shares: a family destroyed so that the ground beneath them can pass to whoever is building the future across it

relatives.title: McCabe & Mrs. Miller
relatives.shares: a company with capital moving in on a small holding, and a woman out of the brothels who understands the business better than the men do

relatives.title: The Wild Bunch
relatives.shares: outlaws finishing their business in a country that the railroad and the money have already taken over

films.title: La Jetée
films.engine: After a war has driven the survivors underground, a prisoner is chosen for time-travel experiments because one childhood image — a woman's face on an airport pier, and a man dying in front of her — is fixed strongly enough in him to survive the passage. He uses the trips to keep returning to her, and when the future offers him permanent refuge he asks instead to go back to that pier, where he discovers the death he has remembered his whole life was his own.

predicaments.situation: captors put a prisoner to use as experimental material because of something private inside him
predicaments.basis: The scientists select him from among the camp's prisoners specifically for the strength of his pre-war memory, and intend to execute him once the mission has succeeded.

predicaments.situation: a person offered survival elsewhere chooses instead to return to someone they can only reach in a place they cannot stay
predicaments.basis: The people of the future offer to take him permanently into their time; he asks to be sent back to the pre-war pier to find the woman.

predicaments.situation: an image someone has carried since childhood turns out to be their own end, witnessed before it happened
predicaments.basis: The startling death he saw on the jetty as a boy is revealed, as he is shot running toward the woman, to have been himself.

predicaments.situation: a bond forms in which only one party knows where the other has come from and how it must end
predicaments.basis: He courts the woman from his memory across repeated visits she experiences as an ordinary romance, while he knows the world it precedes.

predicaments.situation: a ruined society sends a messenger to beg another time for the means to keep living
predicaments.basis: The experiments exist to call past and future to the rescue of the present, and he returns from the future with a power unit sufficient to regenerate his society.

relatives.title: Arrival
relatives.shares: a memory that turns out to be foreknowledge of a loss the person walks into anyway

relatives.title: Oedipus Rex
relatives.shares: a haunting early scene whose meaning, once understood, is the person's own doom already in motion

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: a man organising his life around a woman held as an image, ending back at the place of the first death

relatives.title: Solaris
relatives.shares: a man given the choice between returning to the living world and staying with a beloved who exists only in a recovered form

relatives.title: Je t'aime, je t'aime
relatives.shares: an expendable subject sent through his own memory and drawn repeatedly to one woman and one moment

films.title: Taxi Driver
films.engine: An insomniac veteran drives New York nights, keeps a diary about the filth he sees, and makes two attempts to attach himself to a woman: a campaign worker he takes on a date to a porn theatre, and a twelve-year-old prostitute he decides to send home whether or not she wants to go. Refused by the first, dismissed by the only man he tries to confess his violent thoughts to, he arms himself and goes looking for someone to kill — first a presidential candidate, then, when that fails, the men around the girl — and the city calls the result heroism.

predicaments.situation: a person tries to tell someone how bad it has got inside them and is told they will be fine
predicaments.basis: Travis confides his violent thoughts to Wizard, who brushes them off with reassurance, leaving him unable to articulate the rest.

predicaments.situation: a courtship collapses when one party reveals what he sincerely thinks an evening together should be
predicaments.basis: Travis takes Betsy to an adult movie theatre on their second date; she walks out, refuses reconciliation, and he later storms her workplace to berate her.

predicaments.situation: someone appoints himself the rescuer of a person who has not asked to be rescued
predicaments.basis: Travis buys time with Iris under false pretences in order to argue her out of prostitution, then kills Sport and the others at the brothel; her parents write to thank him.

predicaments.situation: a private rage searches for a public target and settles on whichever one remains reachable
predicaments.basis: Travis trains, buys four handguns, stalks Palantine's rallies, and after the Secret Service chase him off he drives instead to the brothel.

predicaments.situation: an act of slaughter is read by everyone else as heroism and its author is handed back his ordinary life
predicaments.basis: Travis wakes from a coma to newspaper clippings calling him a vigilante hero, faces no prosecution, and returns to driving, with Betsy now a fare who has followed his story.

relatives.title: The Searchers
relatives.shares: a solitary man's obsessive project to retrieve a girl from a life he finds unbearable, driven as much by his own disorder as by her

relatives.title: Le Samouraï
relatives.shares: a man whose entire social existence is a job done alone at night, with ritual and equipment standing in for company

relatives.title: The King of Comedy
relatives.shares: a lonely fantasist whose refusal by the person he fixates on converts directly into a plan against a public figure, and who is celebrated afterward

relatives.title: Falling Down
relatives.shares: an armed, unemployed man walking through a city he has decided is filthy, dispensing correction

relatives.title: Pickpocket
relatives.shares: a drifting solitary narrating his own descent in a diary voice while a small crime becomes a vocation

films.title: La Strada
films.engine: A woman sells her daughter for ten thousand lire to the travelling strongman who took her older daughter away and came back alone. On the road the girl gives him a devotion he uses, punishes and cannot name; another performer tells her that even she has a purpose, and the strongman kills him for mocking him, which empties her out. Only years after abandoning her does he learn she is dead, and it reaches him on a beach with nothing to do about it.

predicaments.situation: a family hands a child over to a stranger's keeping because it cannot feed her
predicaments.basis: Gelsomina's mother takes 10,000 lire from Zampanò to replace Rosa, who died on the road with him, and the girl leaves the same day in tears.

predicaments.situation: one person gives sustained devotion to someone who cannot admit he wants it until she is past reach
predicaments.basis: Gelsomina serves Zampanò, offers him marriage and is brushed off; his tears come only after a stranger's song tells him she died alone.

predicaments.situation: a man who has no answer to being mocked answers with his hands and kills
predicaments.basis: Il Matto needles Zampanò without being able to say why, and a few punches over a flat tire leave him dead in a field.

predicaments.situation: a person in servitude is shown that other lives are available and cannot take one
predicaments.basis: Il Matto argues that she need not stay and that even a pebble has a purpose, a nun offers her another model of a life, and she stays and eventually offers Zampanò marriage.

predicaments.situation: a keeper abandons a dependent who has stopped being useful and later has to hold what that was
predicaments.basis: Zampanò leaves the broken Gelsomina asleep by the road with some clothes, money and his trumpet, and years later collapses on the beach when he learns how she ended.

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: children passed into the hands of a brutal keeper, and a life of servitude entered because a family could not hold together

relatives.title: Ugetsu
relatives.shares: a man who leaves a woman behind for his trade and returns only to learn what her waiting cost her

relatives.title: The Remains of the Day
relatives.shares: devotion offered plainly and refused by someone constitutionally unable to name what he feels, until it is far too late

relatives.title: Vagabond
relatives.shares: a young woman drifting through casual road-side cruelty toward an anonymous death, reconstructed afterward by those who met her

relatives.title: Of Mice and Men
relatives.shares: an itinerant pair bound by dependence rather than choice, where the stronger one's hands end the arrangement

films.title: Blowup
films.engine: A fashion photographer who uses people as material — models he abandons mid-shoot, strangers he shoots without asking — accidentally photographs a killing and, for the first time, needs someone else to confirm what he has seen. Everyone he turns to is too stoned, too bored or too busy to look, the body and the negatives are quietly removed, and the certainty he briefly held evaporates until he can only join a game of catch with a ball that isn't there.

predicaments.situation: one person is certain of something they witnessed and cannot get another person to look at it
predicaments.basis: Thomas begs his agent Ron to come to the park as a witness and Ron, drugged at a party, will not go; by morning the body is gone.

predicaments.situation: someone takes another person's image without consent and refuses to hand it back
predicaments.basis: Thomas photographs Jane and her older lover in the park, keeps shooting as she chases him, and later fobs her off with the wrong roll of film.

predicaments.situation: one party trades intimacy for a thing the other holds, and both sides cheat the exchange
predicaments.basis: Jane comes to the studio, flirts and undresses to get the negatives; he gives her a substitute roll and she gives him a false phone number.

predicaments.situation: a person treats everyone around them as material and finds no one available when they need to be believed
predicaments.basis: He walks out on models mid-session, brushes off the two aspiring girls, dismisses them again after sleeping with them — and then has no one to call on when it matters.

predicaments.situation: someone joins a shared pretence rather than stand outside it alone
predicaments.basis: Thomas throws back the mimes' imaginary tennis ball, and the sound of the ball becomes audible.

relatives.title: The Conversation
relatives.shares: a technician replays his own recording obsessively and cannot make it yield the crime he believes is in it

relatives.title: Caché
relatives.shares: evidence of a watched crime keeps arriving and no perpetrator is ever produced

relatives.title: L'Avventura
relatives.shares: a disappearance stops mattering to everyone around the one person who noticed

relatives.title: Memories of Murder
relatives.shares: the proof keeps being taken away and the investigator is left staring at nothing

relatives.title: Zodiac
relatives.shares: one man's certainty about a killing outlives everyone else's willingness to hear it

films.title: Persona
films.engine: A young nurse is put in charge of an actress who has decided to stop speaking, and takes the silence as the first real listening of her life — telling her about the beach orgy, the pregnancy, the abortion. Then she reads a letter in which the actress is writing her up as a case study, and the care relationship inverts: the one who talked has been emptied out, the one who said nothing has taken what she heard, and by the end the nurse is telling the actress her own life back to her while insisting she is not her.

predicaments.situation: one party goes silent and the other fills the silence until they have given away more than they meant to
predicaments.basis: Elisabet says nothing for weeks while Alma confesses her fiancé, her affair, the orgy on the beach and the abortion.

predicaments.situation: a confidence given in trust turns out to have been collected as material
predicaments.basis: Alma opens the unsealed letter and finds Elisabet reporting that she is 'studying' her, orgy and abortion included.

predicaments.situation: the carer becomes more exposed and more damaged than the person in their care
predicaments.basis: Alma breaks down, threatens Elisabet with boiling water, then chases her to beg forgiveness, while the patient remains composed.

predicaments.situation: a person is mistaken for someone else and does not fully refuse the mistake
predicaments.basis: Elisabet's husband arrives calling Alma by his wife's name; she tells him he is wrong and then sleeps with him anyway.

predicaments.situation: a parent cannot love the child they chose to have, and the child keeps asking anyway
predicaments.basis: Alma narrates Elisabet's motherhood — the wanted pregnancy, the attempted self-abortion, the son she despises who craves her — and Elisabet tears up his photograph.

relatives.title: 3 Women
relatives.shares: two women alone together and one steadily absorbing the other's life and name

relatives.title: Talk to Her
relatives.shares: a carer talks endlessly to a silent patient and builds the whole relationship out of that one-sidedness

relatives.title: The Servant
relatives.shares: the one who serves and the one who is served quietly exchange positions inside a closed house

relatives.title: Vertigo
relatives.shares: one woman is pressed into being another and the identity will not hold

relatives.title: Mulholland Drive
relatives.shares: a confided life story is taken over by the listener until the two figures cannot be separated

films.title: The Battle of Algiers
films.engine: An underground network builds itself cell by cell inside the Casbah and starts killing Europeans in cafés; the army sent to break it works down the chain by torturing each man for the name above him. The film keeps both sides' arithmetic in view — the criminal radicalised in prison and given a role, the colonel doing precisely what his assignment requires — and ends by noting that the side that destroyed the network still lost the country.

predicaments.situation: an occupying force dismantles a clandestine network by extracting from each member the name of the next
predicaments.basis: Ali la Pointe is found because a tortured compatriot gives up his hideout, and the paratroopers work through the FLN leadership the same way.

predicaments.situation: both sides in an armed struggle decide that the other's civilians are legitimate targets
predicaments.basis: The FLN bombs the Milk Bar and other European spots; the security forces answer with indiscriminate killing, torture and intimidation in the Casbah.

predicaments.situation: a man with no politics is radicalised in confinement and handed a place in an organisation
predicaments.basis: Ali la Pointe, a petty criminal, is politicised in prison and recruited by El-Hadi Jafar.

predicaments.situation: an insurgent authority polices its own population before it fights the enemy
predicaments.basis: The FLN takes control of the Casbah by summarily executing Algerian criminals and suspected collaborators.

predicaments.situation: one side wins the engagement and loses the thing the engagement was for
predicaments.basis: The leadership is wiped out, and the coda shows mass demonstrations years later that France cannot answer.

relatives.title: Army of Shadows
relatives.shares: a cell structure eaten from the inside as each arrest yields the next name

relatives.title: Rome, Open City
relatives.shares: an occupier torturing for a network's names while the neighbourhood becomes the resistance's cover

relatives.title: The Wind That Shakes the Barley
relatives.shares: an occupation answered by insurgency where both sides' reprisals fall on people who are not fighting

relatives.title: Zero Dark Thirty
relatives.shares: an interrogation regime treated as an intelligence method with the chain of names as its product

relatives.title: Bloody Sunday
relatives.shares: a colonial-style security operation on a city's own streets that wins the day and loses the population

films.title: Le Samouraï
films.engine: A hitman whose entire life is arranged so that no one can place him is seen clearly by a nightclub pianist who then refuses to identify him — and he cannot work out why. His employers decide that being suspected makes him disposable and try to kill him; he tracks them down, kills the man who ordered it, and then walks into the club in his working gloves and points an empty gun at the one person who protected him, in front of the police.

predicaments.situation: an employer decides a hired man has become a liability and tries to erase him
predicaments.basis: Instead of paying for the Martey job, Jef's contact shoots him in the arm; later the same man offers him money and a fresh contract as a second attempt to manage him.

predicaments.situation: a witness who could name the offender chooses silence, and the reason is never settled between them
predicaments.basis: Valérie sees Jef leaving Martey's office and does not pick him out of the line-up; he assumes his employer instructed her, and she never confirms it.

predicaments.situation: someone arranges their own death so that another hand carries it out
predicaments.basis: Jef makes himself conspicuous at the club, puts on his gloves in full view, and levels a gun the police later find to be unloaded.

predicaments.situation: a person is offered immunity in exchange for withdrawing their cover for someone else, and refuses
predicaments.basis: The police search Jane's flat and promise to leave her alone if she retracts Jef's alibi; she rejects the offer flatly.

predicaments.situation: a man reads the state of his private room to learn that others have been in his life
predicaments.basis: Jef notices loose feathers around the birdcage and finds the police bug they left while planting it.

relatives.title: Branded to Kill
relatives.shares: a contract killer becomes his own organisation's next target and spends the film being hunted by his employers

relatives.title: Point Blank
relatives.shares: a man double-crossed by the outfit that used him walks methodically back up the chain to the person who ordered it

relatives.title: The Killer
relatives.shares: a hitman and the performer who witnessed his work bound together by her refusal to give him up

relatives.title: Ghost Dog: The Way of the Samurai
relatives.shares: a killer living by a private code walks into his own death rather than break it

relatives.title: Le Doulos
relatives.shares: a professional whose survival rests on an alibi held by someone else under police pressure

films.title: The White Ribbon
films.engine: In a village run by a pastor, a doctor and a baron, discipline flows one way: children are shamed, tied to their beds and made to wear white ribbons, a housekeeper is humiliated, a daughter is abused by her father. Then accidents and cruelties start happening to the powerful and their dependents, always to someone weaker than the last, and when the schoolteacher finally says out loud that the children did it, the pastor threatens him with jail — so the village keeps its explanation and the question stays shut.

predicaments.situation: children raised under a regime of purity and punishment reproduce it on those weaker than themselves
predicaments.basis: The pastor's ribbons, confessions and bed-tyings run alongside the caning of the baron's son and the near-blinding of the midwife's handicapped boy, with a scripture verse left behind.

predicaments.situation: a man abuses the dependents of his own household while keeping his standing outside it
predicaments.basis: The doctor is kind to the village children, humiliates the midwife he sleeps with, and sexually abuses his teenage daughter.

predicaments.situation: someone names the culprits and is silenced by the authority of the person they accuse
predicaments.basis: The schoolteacher confronts the pastor in his rectory; the pastor threatens to have him jailed if he repeats it.

predicaments.situation: a community settles on an explanation that spares itself and lets those who left carry the blame
predicaments.basis: The midwife and her son vanish after she says the boy named his attacker, the doctor's family disappears overnight, and rumours settle on them as the cause.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is held hostage to a father's terms
predicaments.basis: Eva's taciturn father grants the schoolteacher permission only after a year's imposed test period.

predicaments.situation: people at the bottom of a household hierarchy strike at its property because the person is out of reach
predicaments.basis: The dead farmworker's son destroys the baron's cabbage field, a barn burns, and a wire brings the doctor down from his horse.

roles.striking: the farmer's son and the unnamed others

relatives.title: Dogtooth
relatives.shares: children formed entirely by a household's disciplinary system and the violence that grows inside it

relatives.title: The Hunt
relatives.shares: a village settles on the explanation that costs it least and turns on the person who disturbs it

relatives.title: Lord of the Flies
relatives.shares: children administering punishment among themselves in the exact grammar the adults taught them

relatives.title: Fanny and Alexander
relatives.shares: a clergyman's household run on confession, shame and physical punishment of children

relatives.title: Doubt
relatives.shares: an accusation that cannot be proved, made against a man whose office is itself the defence

films.title: Street of Shame
films.engine: Five women working at a licensed Tokyo brothel each try to get out through somebody else — a client's savings, a father, a husband, a son, a marriage — and every exit turns out to be held by a person who wants something from them in return. The law that would close the trade fails to pass, the one woman who stops depending on anyone buys the shop next door and sells back to the house, and a young maid steps into the doorway to start.

predicaments.situation: one party pays another's debts believing it has purchased a shared future
predicaments.basis: Mr Aoki embezzles to clear Yasumi's debts on the understanding that she will elope with him; when he learns she never intended to, he nearly kills her.

predicaments.situation: a grown child confronts a parent over how the family was kept, and refuses the parent's claim
predicaments.basis: Mickey throws out the father who comes to bring her home, telling him he indulged himself while her mother was alive.

predicaments.situation: a child disowns a parent for the work that fed them
predicaments.basis: Yumeko finally meets the son she has been avoiding out of shame; he denounces her profession and cuts her off, and she loses her mind.

predicaments.situation: someone escapes an exploitative arrangement into another one wearing a kinder name
predicaments.basis: Yorie's debts are voided and she leaves to marry, then comes back to Dreamland having found the man only wanted unpaid labour.

predicaments.situation: a person carrying a household alone is sunk by the dependents they are carrying
predicaments.basis: Hanae works to keep a suicidal husband and an infant and the family is evicted anyway.

predicaments.situation: one person converts the trade that held them into a business that others must now pay
predicaments.basis: Yasumi recovers, buys the futon and fabric shop next door, and the brothel becomes her customer while a new girl is put in the doorway.

relatives.title: Nights of Cabiria
relatives.shares: a woman's savings and her way out of the trade taken by the man who promised marriage

relatives.title: Vivre sa vie
relatives.shares: a woman's dealings with clients, minders and debts treated as an ordinary economic arrangement

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: adult children who have no room left for the parent whose work paid for them

relatives.title: Working Girls
relatives.shares: a brothel run as a workplace where each woman is saving toward a different exit

relatives.title: Rosetta
relatives.shares: someone fighting for a foothold in work while every route out is controlled by somebody else

films.title: Memories of Murder
films.engine: Two policemen with incompatible ways of knowing a person are set against a killer who leaves nothing either of them can read: one trusts his eyes and his partner's fists, the other trusts paper, timing and the lab. Over three years the case wears them into each other's positions — the instinct man ends up with nothing to trust, the evidence man ends up wanting to shoot on a hunch — while the people nearest the case, a handicapped boy who saw something, a woman who survived, are used up and lost.

predicaments.situation: a search for a culprit exhausts itself and the searchers have to go on living without the answer
predicaments.basis: The DNA comparison comes back neither confirming nor excluding the suspect, he is let go, and seventeen years later the detective is a businessman standing at the first crime scene learning the man looks like anybody.

predicaments.situation: two people forced to work the same problem believe truth is reached in opposite ways
predicaments.basis: Park claims he can identify a suspect by eye contact while Seo builds patterns from crime reports, rainy nights and red clothing; by the end each has adopted the other's method.

predicaments.situation: investigators extract a confession from someone who cannot defend himself against them
predicaments.basis: Cho beats a scarred, mentally handicapped boy into confessing to the murders on the strength of a rumour that he followed one of the victims.

predicaments.situation: the one person who could say what happened is destroyed before he can be heard
predicaments.basis: Once they realise Baek actually witnessed a murder, they chase him and he stumbles into a train.

predicaments.situation: a watcher fails at the moment of watching and someone dies in the gap
predicaments.basis: Seo falls asleep during his surveillance of Hyeon-gyu and the schoolgirl he had befriended is murdered that night.

relatives.title: Zodiac
relatives.shares: a hunt that outlasts the hunters and closes on certainty without proof

relatives.title: Cure
relatives.shares: a killer whose ordinariness defeats the very idea of recognising him

relatives.title: In the Heat of the Night
relatives.shares: two investigators with opposed methods and mutual contempt yoked to one killing

relatives.title: L'Avventura
relatives.shares: a search that quietly stops mattering and leaves the searchers changed instead of answered

relatives.title: Blow-Up
relatives.shares: evidence examined past the point where it can yield the truth it seemed to hold

films.title: Yeelen
films.engine: A father who has learned to use sacred knowledge for himself gets a vision that his son will end him, and decides to hunt the boy down rather than let anything pass to the next generation. The son, armed by his mother with stolen fetishes and by a blind uncle who long ago spent his sight using the same power for other people, walks the length of the country toward the meeting he cannot avoid. What the two of them are actually fighting over is whether the old man hands anything on or takes it into the ground with him.

predicaments.situation: a father sets out to destroy his son rather than be succeeded by him
predicaments.basis: Soma receives a vision that Nianankoro will cause his death and pursues him across the country with an enchanted tracking pylon.

predicaments.situation: a holder of power must choose between hoarding it and letting it be spread among everyone
predicaments.basis: Soma warns the Komo that his son means to disperse their magic for all people, while the uncle Djigui was blinded because he chose to use Kore's Wing on his community's behalf.

predicaments.situation: a mother arms her child against his own father
predicaments.basis: Nianankoro's mother helps him steal Soma's sacred fetishes and get out of the village.

predicaments.situation: a stranger buys his life with his usefulness and then commits the one offence his host cannot overlook
predicaments.basis: King Rouma spares Nianankoro for the magic that routs his enemies, then must judge him for sleeping with the queen he was asked to cure, and marries them off and sends them away.

predicaments.situation: what a parent meant to pass on reaches the child only after the parent is dead
predicaments.basis: Nianankoro leaves his cloak with the pregnant Attou for his son, and the boy collects it, an egg and Kore's Wing at the scorched site where his father and grandfather killed each other.

relatives.title: The Return
relatives.shares: a father and son whose reunion can only be settled by one of them dying

relatives.title: Padre Padrone
relatives.shares: a father who keeps knowledge from his son to keep him beneath him

relatives.title: Sansho the Bailiff
relatives.shares: a father's teaching carried across a country by a child who must decide whether to live by it

relatives.title: The Ballad of Narayama
relatives.shares: the older generation's obligation to clear out so the next one can hold what it held

relatives.title: Excalibur
relatives.shares: an elder's refusal to relinquish power and an heir who must take it by force

films.title: Killers of the Flower Moon
films.engine: An uncle who has spent years being the reservation's friendly white benefactor places his nephew inside an Osage family as a husband, having explained in advance exactly what each death in that family will be worth in oil rights. The nephew does it — courts her, marries her, raises three children with her, arranges the killings of her sisters and eventually measures out the poison into her insulin himself. The film is about a woman watching her whole family die around her while the person doing it sleeps beside her, and about an entire county agreeing not to notice.

predicaments.situation: someone marries into a family in order to inherit what killing that family will release
predicaments.basis: Hale steers Ernest toward Mollie and explains that every death among her relatives moves headrights toward them.

predicaments.situation: the community's declared protector is the one destroying it
predicaments.basis: Hale poses as benefactor, reserve deputy and friend to the Osage while contracting the murders of its wealthiest members.

predicaments.situation: a people is ruled incompetent to hold what is legally theirs and put under appointed guardians
predicaments.basis: Federal law requires court-appointed white guardians to manage the money of full and half-blood Osage.

predicaments.situation: victims bring their case to authorities already owned by the person harming them
predicaments.basis: The sheriff and judges are in Hale's pocket, the private detective Mollie hires is beaten by Ernest and Byron, and the Osage envoy sent to Washington is killed there.

predicaments.situation: a person is slowly poisoned by the one who administers their medicine
predicaments.basis: Ernest doses Mollie's insulin at Hale's instruction to "slow her down", and she is found near death before agents get her to a hospital.

predicaments.situation: someone is asked to testify against the family member who formed him
predicaments.basis: White persuades Ernest to turn state's evidence against Hale; he does so after his daughter dies, but will not admit the poisoning and Mollie leaves him.

relatives.title: Gaslight
relatives.shares: a husband methodically destroying his wife's health for what she owns

relatives.title: Shadow of a Doubt
relatives.shares: the beloved relative who is the killer, sheltered by the family's affection for him

relatives.title: Chinatown
relatives.shares: a patriarch who owns the officials, the water and the family, so no complaint can reach anyone

relatives.title: Rosemary's Baby
relatives.shares: a husband who trades his wife to an older man's design in exchange for advancement

relatives.title: The Chess Players
relatives.shares: a people relieved of what is theirs through legal paperwork rather than open force

films.title: Aftersun
films.engine: A separated father takes his eleven-year-old daughter on a cheap Turkish package holiday and spends the week hiding how badly he is doing from the one person watching him closely enough to notice — old enough to sense the wrongness, too young to name it or do anything about it. Twenty years later, herself the age he was that week, she plays back the camcorder tapes trying to find what was standing in front of her the whole time.

predicaments.situation: an adult hides their despair from a child who half-perceives it anyway
predicaments.basis: Calum keeps up a contented front, hiding his smoking, reading self-help books alone and telling the diving instructor he is surprised he reached thirty, while Sophie keeps catching the edges of it.

predicaments.situation: a child ends up doing the comforting for the parent meant to be looking after them
predicaments.basis: Sophie sees through his shrug about the expensive lost scuba mask and consoles him, and later covers his sleeping body with a sheet.

predicaments.situation: one person refuses a small public gesture of togetherness and wounds the one who set it up
predicaments.basis: Sophie signs them both up for karaoke and Calum will not sing; she performs alone, then refuses to come back to the room.

predicaments.situation: someone leaves an object and a message intended to stand in for them later on
predicaments.basis: Calum goes back alone to buy the rug he could not justify, and writes Sophie a postcard telling her never to forget he loves her; the worn rug lies on her bedroom floor in New York.

predicaments.situation: a person plays back a recording to find what they failed to see while it was happening
predicaments.basis: The adult Sophie, with a wife and child of her own, watches the MiniDV footage she shot at eleven.

predicaments.situation: someone reaches for a person across a distance that will not close
predicaments.basis: In the strobing rave sequences the adult Sophie works toward Calum, holds him briefly, and he slips out of her hands.

relatives.title: Bicycle Thieves
relatives.shares: a child at their father's side watching a collapse he is trying to keep from them

relatives.title: Mirror
relatives.shares: an adult assembling a parent out of fragments of memory and film that will not resolve

relatives.title: Ikiru
relatives.shares: a man carrying a private verdict on himself and performing normality for the people closest to him

relatives.title: Sans Soleil
relatives.shares: footage treated as the only remaining route back into a moment already gone

films.title: Autumn Sonata
films.engine: A daughter invites her mother, a touring concert pianist, for a first visit in seven years, and over one night hands her the account she has been keeping: that the career and the lovers came first, that she was talked into an abortion by the man she loved, that the disabled sister now in her house was left to get worse. The mother defends herself, then breaks and asks forgiveness, then boards a train the next morning and wonders aloud why the sister couldn't have died. The invitation was a summons, and what it opens can be neither withdrawn nor repaired.

predicaments.situation: a grown child summons a parent in order to present the bill for their childhood
predicaments.basis: Eva's hospitable letter after seven years turns into an all-night accusation of emotional abandonment and coercion.

predicaments.situation: someone who cannot be understood by anyone but one person calls out for the one who will not come
predicaments.basis: Helena, whose fragmented speech only Eva can read, drags herself from bed toward the stairs crying "Mama, come!" while Charlotte stays away.

predicaments.situation: the more gifted party corrects the lesser one's effort and presents the correction as help
predicaments.basis: After Eva plays the Chopin prelude, Charlotte sits down and immediately performs it better.

predicaments.situation: a parent offers possessions in place of the presence that was never given
predicaments.basis: Charlotte hands Helena a wristwatch on arrival and muses aloud about giving Eva her car and simply buying another.

predicaments.situation: a witness to a confrontation decides to stay out of it
predicaments.basis: Viktor listens to the whole reckoning from the next room and does not come in; at the end he reads Eva's letter aloud and seals it.

predicaments.situation: an attempt at repair is made only after the other person has already gone
predicaments.basis: Eva, returning from her drowned son's grave, writes an apology letter to her departed mother whose delivery the film leaves undecided.

relatives.title: Festen
relatives.shares: a family gathering converted by one child into the delivery of a long-prepared indictment

relatives.title: Long Day's Journey into Night
relatives.shares: a single night in which a family says out loud everything it has been avoiding, and nothing improves

relatives.title: The Piano Teacher
relatives.shares: a mother and daughter bound together by music and by mutual, unpayable damage

relatives.title: Tokyo Story
relatives.shares: a visit between parent and grown child in which the duty is performed and the affection cannot be

relatives.title: Rachel Getting Married
relatives.shares: a homecoming that reopens a child's death and the question of who is held responsible for it

films.title: Jules and Jim
films.engine: Two friends who love the same woman decide the friendship is worth more than the exclusive claim, and so they pass her between them by agreement — one marries her, then invites the other to marry her rather than lose her entirely. She takes every freedom she is offered and finds that no arrangement, marriage or blessing holds her, and when the second man finally refuses her she kills them both.

predicaments.situation: two people who love each other as friends love the same third person and try to keep the friendship above the rivalry
predicaments.basis: Jules and Jim meet Catherine together, remain inseparable as a trio, and neither ever treats the other as an enemy over her.

predicaments.situation: one partner hands the other over to a rival rather than lose their presence altogether
predicaments.basis: Fearing Catherine will leave him for good, Jules gives Jim his blessing to marry her so that he can go on living near her and their daughter.

predicaments.situation: a bond survives on the promise of a child that never arrives
predicaments.basis: Jim and Catherine's happy life in the chalet breaks apart over their failure to conceive, and their planned reunion is cancelled by her miscarriage.

predicaments.situation: someone refused a final time destroys themselves and the refuser together
predicaments.basis: After Jim rebuffs her and says he will marry Gilberte, Catherine asks him into her car and drives it off a broken bridge into the river.

predicaments.situation: friends are conscripted onto opposite sides of a war and each dreads having killed the other
predicaments.basis: Jules serves Austria and Jim France, and each spends the war fearing he will meet or has already killed his friend.

relatives.title: Design for Living
relatives.shares: two friends formalise sharing the woman they both love rather than break with each other

relatives.title: Sangam
relatives.shares: one friend steps aside so the other can marry the woman, and the arrangement curdles into catastrophe

relatives.title: Y tu mamá también
relatives.shares: a woman moves between two inseparable male friends and exposes what the friendship could not survive

relatives.title: Vicky Cristina Barcelona
relatives.shares: a love arrangement rebuilt by mutual consent that still cannot hold the person at its centre

relatives.title: The Story of Adele H.
relatives.shares: a person who will destroy themselves rather than accept a refusal

films.title: Mother Joan of the Angels
films.engine: A priest is sent to exorcise an abbess whose predecessors have failed and whose last confessor was burned for tempting the nuns; what he finds in her, and in himself, is desire that neither of them can name except as possession. Rather than cure her, he asks for her demons, takes them into himself, and murders two innocent men so that her damnation will be his — then sends word to her that it was done out of love.

predicaments.situation: the person sent to cure an affliction takes it into themselves instead
predicaments.basis: Father Suryn re-enters the convent and receives Mother Joan's demons through his love for her, leaving her unburdened and himself possessed.

predicaments.situation: two people bound by vows can only express desire for each other as sickness or holiness
predicaments.basis: Mother Joan tries to seduce Suryn while begging him to make her a saint, and neither can approach the other except through possession and exorcism.

predicaments.situation: someone commits an atrocity as a gift to another and asks that it be reported to them as love
predicaments.basis: Suryn kills the stablemen Kaziuk and Juraj with an axe and instructs Margareth to tell Mother Joan of the sacrifice he made for her salvation.

predicaments.situation: one member of a closed community leaves it for a lover and is abandoned outside
predicaments.basis: Sister Małgorzata leaves the convent for the squire Chrząszczewski, becomes Margareth, and is discarded by him the next morning.

predicaments.situation: outsiders make an entertainment out of an enclosed institution's disgrace
predicaments.basis: The villagers at the inn track the convent's scandal, with Kaziuk pressing Sister Małgorzata for stories on her nightly visits.

relatives.title: The Devils
relatives.shares: possession inside a convent that is inseparable from forbidden desire and the men sent to judge it

relatives.title: Black Narcissus
relatives.shares: enclosed religious women undone by longing that has no permitted form

relatives.title: Diary of a Country Priest
relatives.shares: a priest who takes the sickness of the souls he tends into his own body

relatives.title: Breaking the Waves
relatives.shares: someone who damns themselves deliberately, offering the damnation as an act of love

relatives.title: Silence
relatives.shares: a priest who concludes that saving another requires committing the sin he was sent to fight

films.title: Safety Last!
films.engine: A young man leaves town promising to send for his girlfriend once he has made good, fails, and covers it with gifts he cannot afford. When she believes the gifts and simply arrives, he has to keep an invented promotion standing in front of her in real time — and the twelve-storey climb he sells to the store is the price of holding the lie up until it becomes true.

predicaments.situation: someone sends home evidence of a success they have not actually had
predicaments.basis: Harold, a struggling salesclerk, mails Mildred expensive presents he cannot afford so she will think he has made good in the city.

predicaments.situation: the person deceived arrives in person and the deceiver must sustain the false identity face to face
predicaments.basis: Mildred takes a train to join him, and Harold has to impersonate the store's general manager in front of her, and to Stubbs.

predicaments.situation: one person contracts a dangerous job out to a friend and ends up having to do it themselves
predicaments.basis: Harold sells the store on a human-fly stunt to be performed by Bill, but the pursuing policeman keeps Bill from taking over, so Harold climbs every floor himself.

predicaments.situation: a prank on the wrong person turns a friend into a fugitive from an authority who cannot tell one man from another
predicaments.basis: Bill knocks over a policeman Harold mistook for his hometown friend, and the officer's vow to arrest him on sight wrecks the stunt.

relatives.title: Catch Me If You Can
relatives.shares: a status lie that has to be performed live and keeps escalating to stay upright

relatives.title: Shree 420
relatives.shares: a young man arriving in the big city and manufacturing the success he promised

relatives.title: The Cameraman
relatives.shares: an incompetent bluffing his way into a job to keep the woman who believes in him

relatives.title: The Apartment
relatives.shares: advancement bought with a pretense that nearly costs the man the person he loves

relatives.title: Sons of the Desert
relatives.shares: a fabrication maintained face to face with the very person it was told to

films.title: The Red Shoes
films.engine: An impresario with no private life of his own makes it a condition of employment that his dancers have none either, and a young dancer who tells him dancing is the most important thing in her life is taken literally. When she marries the composer, her husband and her impresario each make their claim exclusive, and forced to choose between the man who loves her and the man who gives her the work, she goes to the stage and then off it in front of a train.

predicaments.situation: a mentor demands total devotion and treats any love outside the work as betrayal
predicaments.basis: Boris dismisses his prima ballerina for marrying and, though not in love with Vicky himself, gives Julian the ultimatum to leave her or leave the company.

predicaments.situation: two people each make their claim on a third exclusive, forcing a choice that cannot be survived
predicaments.basis: Julian insists Vicky cancel her comeback and leave with him while Boris insists she dance, and after their argument she chooses the company and kills herself minutes later.

predicaments.situation: in a marriage of two working artists one career advances while the other stalls, and the sacrifice falls on one side
predicaments.basis: Julian's opera opens at Covent Garden while Vicky's dancing goes nowhere, and Boris wins her back by pointing out that she is the one giving things up.

predicaments.situation: a fiction staged for an audience comes true for the person performing it
predicaments.basis: Vicky dies exactly as her character in The Ballet of the Red Shoes does, and asks Julian to take the shoes off; the company then dances the ballet around the empty space where she should be.

predicaments.situation: a junior exposes a superior's theft of their work and is rewarded rather than punished
predicaments.basis: Julian writes to Boris denouncing his professor's plagiarism, tries to retract it, and is hired instead.

relatives.title: Black Swan
relatives.shares: a director's total claim on a dancer collapsing the distance between the role and her life

relatives.title: The Story of the Last Chrysanthemum
relatives.shares: one partner's art sustained entirely by the other's unacknowledged sacrifice

relatives.title: Whiplash
relatives.shares: a mentor who insists excellence requires the destruction of everything else the pupil has

relatives.title: Phantom Thread
relatives.shares: an artist who demands that a partner be subordinated to the work's discipline

relatives.title: A Star Is Born
relatives.shares: a marriage in which two careers move in opposite directions and the difference becomes fatal

films.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
films.engine: A lawyer who believes in law over guns is credited with a killing he did not do, and builds a career from governor to near vice-president on it. The rancher who actually fired the shot keeps quiet, watches the woman he intended to marry attach herself to the man he made, burns down the house he had extended for her, and dies poor — and when the truth is finally offered to a newspaper, the editor burns his reporter's notes.

predicaments.situation: one person is credited for another's decisive act, and the one who did it insists the truth stay buried
predicaments.basis: Tom Doniphon shot Valance from the shadows at the same instant Ranse fired, tells only Ranse, and urges him to take the nomination anyway.

predicaments.situation: someone withdraws from the person they meant to marry after seeing where her affection has gone, and never contests it
predicaments.basis: Tom, who had built rooms onto his ranch for Hallie, sees her tending Ranse's wound, gets drunk and sets fire to the house intending to die in it.

predicaments.situation: a person committed to law and argument must live in a place that answers only to force
predicaments.basis: Ranse opens a school and files a practice while Valance beats him twice and finally calls him out, and only a bullet ends the matter.

predicaments.situation: a keeper of the public record chooses the useful story over the true one
predicaments.basis: The Shinbone Star's editor listens to Ranse's confession, burns the reporter's notes, and says he prints the legend.

predicaments.situation: a marriage is lived alongside an unspoken grief for someone else
predicaments.basis: Hallie admits to Ranse that she laid a cactus rose on Tom's coffin, and the two ride back to Washington in silence.

relatives.title: Cyrano de Bergerac
relatives.shares: a man's decisive act credited to another while he silently gives up the woman they both love

relatives.title: Casablanca
relatives.shares: a man who steps back so the woman goes with the one whose public life needs her

relatives.title: Hero
relatives.shares: an account of a killing deliberately falsified because the truth would be worse for everyone

relatives.title: The Assassination of Jesse James by the Coward Robert Ford
relatives.shares: a reputation built on one shot, and the gap between the legend and what actually happened

relatives.title: Sholay
relatives.shares: a friend who quietly withdraws his claim on a woman and dies unrewarded for what he did

films.title: Gladiator
films.engine: An emperor tells his general he will pass over his own son and make him regent; the son hears it, kills the father, and has the general's wife and child murdered. Sold as a slave, the general works his way back to Rome inside the arena, where he takes from the son the one thing he actually wants — the crowd — and finally kills him in front of it.

predicaments.situation: a parent names an outsider as heir over their own child, and the child kills them for it
predicaments.basis: Marcus Aurelius tells Maximus that Commodus is unfit to rule and asks him to serve as regent; Commodus, having heard it, smothers his father and takes the throne.

predicaments.situation: a person stripped of family, rank and name spends everything afterwards getting back to the one who ordered it
predicaments.basis: Maximus finds his wife and son murdered, is sold to a gladiator school, and fights his way to the Colosseum specifically to reach Commodus.

predicaments.situation: a ruler needs the affection of a crowd that has already given it to the man he most wants dead
predicaments.basis: Commodus stages 150 days of games to win the public, only to watch them chant for Maximus and force him to spare his enemy's life.

predicaments.situation: a sibling must manage the affection of a dangerous relative to keep their own child alive
predicaments.basis: Lucilla conspires with Maximus and Gracchus while Commodus demands she give him an heir and threatens both her and Lucius.

predicaments.situation: subordinates decide at the decisive moment whether the man in power is still owed obedience
predicaments.basis: Quintus, who once arrested Maximus on Commodus' orders, refuses to hand the emperor a sword in the arena and later helps carry Maximus out.

predicaments.situation: men held in bondage together honour each other's dead when the fight is over
predicaments.basis: Proximo and his gladiators die covering Maximus' escape, and Juba buries the figurines of Maximus' wife and son in the arena floor.

relatives.title: Ben-Hur
relatives.shares: a man stripped of family and freedom who returns through the arena to face the one responsible

relatives.title: Ran
relatives.shares: a father's decision about succession that his sons answer with murder

relatives.title: The Lion King
relatives.shares: an uncle who kills for the throne and an exiled heir who returns to take it back

relatives.title: The Count of Monte Cristo
relatives.shares: total dispossession converted patiently into an instrument aimed at the man who caused it

relatives.title: Spartacus
relatives.shares: slaves in the arena turning the spectacle staged for their masters into a political weapon
